features.definition: Dominant body color is blue or cyan (0=not blue, 1=clearly blue dominant)
Dominant body color is green (0=not green, 1=clearly green dominant)
Dominant body color is brown, tan, or orange-brown (0=not, 1=clearly dominant)
Dominant body color is red or dark red (0=not, 1=clearly red dominant)
Has visible wings or wing-like appendages (0=no, 1=yes)
Primarily four-legged body posture (0=no, 1=yes)
Primarily bipedal/upright body posture (0=no, 1=yes)
Body is primarily serpentine or worm-like without clear limbs (0=no, 1=yes)
Body is blob-like, gelatinous, or amorphous without clear limbs (0=no, 1=yes)
Has visible plant-like features (leaves, vines, flowers, bark) (0=none, 1=heavily plant-based)
Has metallic, mechanical, or robotic features (0=none, 1=heavily mechanical)
Has fur, fluff, or fluffy texture visible (0=no, 1=yes clearly)
Has scales or reptilian appearance (0=no, 1=clearly reptilian/scaly)
Has smooth skin without fur/scales/feathers (0=no, 1=clearly smooth-skinned)
Has feathers or bird-like appearance (0=no, 1=clearly avian/feathered)
Appears large/bulky relative to typical Pokémon (0=small/tiny, 1=very large/bulky)
Has a visible tail (0=no, 1=yes)
Has visible claws or talons (0=no, 1=yes)
Overall color scheme is dark (dark blue, black, dark brown) (0=light/bright, 1=very dark)
Image shows more than one creature or a combined/duo form (0=single creature, 1=multiple/duo)
Has insect-like features (antennae, compound eyes, many legs, exoskeleton) (0=none, 1=clearly insect/bug)
Has water/aquatic theme (fins, flippers, water droplets, aquatic body shape) (0=none, 1=clearly aquatic)
Has fire-like features (flame patterns, fire mane, fiery colors) (0=none, 1=clearly fire-themed)
Has ghost or dark/spooky appearance (floating, wispy, dark aura) (0=none, 1=clearly ghost/dark)
Eyes are unusually large or prominent relative to body (0=normal eyes, 1=very large/prominent eyes)
Overall visual complexity and detail level (0=very simple/minimal, 1=very complex/detailed)

Has a natural, organic, earth-toned appearance without strong artificial or elemental (water/fire/electric/steel) visual theme - looks like it belongs in a forest or natural environment (0=strongly elemental or artificial, 1=purely natural/organic)
Has yellow, tan, or golden accents or secondary colors prominently visible (0=no yellow/tan accents, 1=clearly has yellow or tan highlights)

The Pokémon appears to be made of metal, machinery, manufactured objects, or artificial materials rather than flesh/organic matter. Score 1 if clearly mechanical/artificial (gears, bolts, metal body, manufactured appearance), 0 if clearly biological/organic.

notes: The user seems to be grouping by organic/living creatures vs mechanical/artificial ones. item_007 (mechanical bell) is far from all organic Pokémon including blue ones like item_004. The key separator is mechanical_features - items with high mechanical scores should be in a different group. natural_organic_appearance should be heavily weighted to keep organic creatures together and push mechanical ones away. Brown/tan earthy ones form a sub-cluster, but the main split is organic vs mechanical.
